notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {R}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}{R}.
Cast Crown of Flames by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
